sources.entry: Joomla! - Advanced Content Management System (CMS). (Source Code) GPL-2.0 PHP
Joomla | Popular content management system for websites

summary.one_liner: Joomla! CMS source code: the PHP content management system for building websites and online applications, distributed from its main development branch.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes this repository as the source of Joomla! 6.x, a Content Management System for building websites and online applications. It runs on a server with PHP and either MySQL, MariaDB or PostgreSQL. The README says the repository is not an installable package; it gives links for stable and nightly packages instead. To run from source, the README walks through cloning the repo, checking out the 6.2-dev branch, and installing dependencies with Composer and npm (npm compiles the JavaScript and SASS files). It also notes that Joomla caches extension namespaces in an autoload file that must be deleted when extensions change. The README sets out a branch policy: bug fixes target 6.2-dev and feature or minor changes target 6.3-dev.
use_cases: build a website with a content management system
build online applications on PHP and MySQL or PostgreSQL
run a Joomla development environment from source
study the source code of a PHP CMS
how_to_run: git clone (repository URL not included in README text)
notable: Official source repository for Joomla! 6.x, developed by Open Source Matters with community contributors
Branch policy separates bug fixes (6.2-dev) from feature and minor changes (6.3-dev)
Supports MySQL, MariaDB and PostgreSQL databases
caveats: Not installable out of the box from this repository; the README points to separate stable and nightly packages
Source setup requires PHP CLI, Composer, Node.js and Git
Development is on the 6.2-dev branch, so the default branch may not match what you want to run
